top_choice_rationale: The optical lattice clock (Katori, Ye) is a clean two-name credit for a specific invention, magic-wavelength trapping, whose performance near 1e-18 has been confirmed across independent laboratories and is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. Twisted bilayer graphene (P002) is a genuine discovery with secure phenomenology but an unsettled pairing mechanism and a thin experimental credit; it is preferable to no award, which is not warranted given a mature candidate.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my ties are to PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGOLite/PoGO+ and XL-Calibur, none touching the clock or twisted bilayer graphene proposals
